name: Swadeshi Industries & Leasing Limited
about: Swadeshi Industries & Leasing Limited trades in various and incidental activities products in India. The company also manufactures and supplies preservative-free grocery products; copper; and supplying of preservative free food and waterless dyeing processes for textiles. It serves food and food grains, FMCG industry, textile, copper, and service sectors for operation and management of MSME parks. The company was incorporated in 1974 and is based in Mumbai, India.
